readme.guidance: Research spreadsheet of Tamil Nadu's 38 districts, their administrative background, historical-name context and official portals.
Former administrative district, former English spelling, ancient settlement name, historical region (nadu/seemai), and newly formed district are different categories.
Do not treat a regional name as the ancient name of the entire modern district unless the source explicitly supports that geographic scope.
Where an exact Government Order or renaming authority has not been verified, the row says to verify it rather than guessing.
For project/database use, add one record per name-claim with period, source title/page, URL, evidence type, geographic scope, and confidence.
